klaim.bukti: It increases MOTA and IDF1 by 5% to 6%, while decreasing ID switches by 62%. SORT+ improves the counting accuracy from 33% to 96%.
klaim.catatan: Tanaman (anggur, UAV), metode, dan ketiga angka sesuai abstrak.

klaim.bukti: SORT+ and DeepSORT+ incorporate a novel matching cascade that leverages the complementary strengths of Mahalanobis, IoU, and Euclidean distances. [...] making the training-free SORT+ comparable to the deep-learning-based DeepSORT.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak menyebut "comparable to DeepSORT" tanpa menyebut metrik; kata "accuracy" di naskah adalah penafsiran yang masih wajar.

klaim.bukti: the fruit matching model obtained an F1-Score of 0.816 and 0.864 for both apple and orange, with good accuracy, precision, and recall.
klaim.catatan: Penugasan satu-ke-satu memakai algoritma Kuhn-Munkres; F1 diukur pada 20 kelompok pasangan citra bersebelahan per jenis buah.

yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar (abstrak disembunyikan penerbit); Crossref dan OpenAlex (tanpa abstrak); WebSearch gagal karena kuota sesi habis; WebFetch halaman Springer berhasil memuat abstrak.

klaim.bukti: [parafrasa web] Abstrak di halaman Springer: jaringan dengan dua kepala, re-identification dan klasifikasi kematangan, menjaga konsistensi track; counting-by-tracking mencapai MAPE 3% (L1 = 7) dibanding 21% (L1 = 41) pada baseline pelacakan multiobjek.
klaim.catatan: Klaim bersifat kualitatif dan sesuai judul serta abstrak. Jenis buah spesifik tidak disebut di abstrak. Teks lengkap tidak terjangkau.

klaim.bukti: The error on identifying duplicate apples was found to be 21.1%. Overall, the method achieved an accuracy of 82% on estimating crop-load on trees with dual side imaging compared to 58% with single side imaging.
klaim.catatan: Angka, tanaman (apel, tall spindle), dan label M4 (lokasi 3D untuk membuang duplikat) sesuai. Sel acuan "Manual count" tidak disebut di abstrak sehingga tidak dapat diperiksa.

klaim.bukti: Overall, the method achieved an accuracy of 82% on estimating crop-load on trees with dual side imaging compared to 58% with single side imaging.
klaim.perbaikan: The 58% is a crop-load estimation accuracy with single-side imaging, not a share of fruit seen, and it is not a minority. Reword, e.g.: "...and in the apple study of [gongal2016apple] single-side imaging reached only 58% crop-load estimation accuracy against 82% with both sides."
klaim.catatan: Angka 58% benar, tetapi kalimat memakainya sebagai bukti bahwa satu sisi melihat "minoritas" buah. Angka itu adalah akurasi estimasi muatan buah dan nilainya di atas 50%.

klaim.bukti: The location of apples in three-dimensional (3D) space was used to eliminate duplicate counting of apples that were visible to cameras from both sides of the tree canopy. The error on identifying duplicate apples was found to be 21.1%.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak menulis "error on identifying duplicate apples 21.1%"; definisi galat tidak dirinci di abstrak, sehingga rumusan yang paling aman mengikuti frasa sumber.

klaim.bukti: The proposed model achieves high detection (90.8%) and counting (95.2%) accuracy with a compact size of 3.98 MB and 5.3 GFLOPs, while the proposed MVC method reduces counting errors by 95.6%.
klaim.catatan: Angka 95,6% dan tanaman (tomat ceri) sesuai. Abstrak tidak menyebut pembanding secara eksplisit; sel "with and without multi-view compensation" adalah penafsiran yang belum terperiksa pada teks lengkap.
